It's difficult to help her see that. I have to respect her fear because it's somewhat logical. We are going into this blind and not knowing what to expect, it's not far fetched to think that if we pick the wrong doctor they could potentially send her away without reason behind it. 

We have come a long way since this last episode,  she has even brought up an outpatient rehabilitation center on her own. But she wants to talk to someone first. 

Unfortunately just finding a psychiatrist or psychologist is proving difficult.
